# The Marketing School
> The Marketing School runs ads for businesses as a done-for-you service, with AI installed in their ad accounts. It also sets up AI across a business's marketing through AI Implementation. Full Agency is available, by application, for accounts spending $30k+ a month.

## Offer 1: Done-For-You Ads
- What it is: we run your ads for you with AI-powered management, on 1 or 2 platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn).
- Who it is for: businesses spending under $10k a month on ads.
- Includes: a done-for-you AI install in your ad accounts to find wasted spend, write ads, and report results; a monthly results report.
- Guarantee: If you're not getting better results in 90 days, we'll refund our fee. Refund covers our fee only. Ad spend paid to Google, Meta, and other platforms isn't refundable.
- Optional add-ons: ad creative and CRM setup.
- How to start: fill out the short form at https://www.themarketingschool.com/contact to book a free account review call. There is no online checkout.
- Details: https://www.themarketingschool.com/done-for-you-ads

## Offer 2: AI Implementation
- What it is: we install and set up AI in your marketing and ad accounts for ad writing, wasted spend checks, and reporting.
- How to start: book a free account review at https://www.themarketingschool.com/contact.

## Full Agency (apply only)
- We make the ads and run them: media buying on Google, Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn, creative (static and video), a dedicated strategist, weekly 1:1 reporting, and landing page and funnel builds.
- Built for accounts spending $30k+/mo on ads. 90-day minimum.
- Details: https://www.themarketingschool.com/done-for-you-ads

## Free
- Free account review: fill out a short form and Evan goes over your ad accounts with you on a call: https://www.themarketingschool.com/contact

## Founder
- Evan Baker, founder. 20+ years running paid media on Google, Meta, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Founded Crowdfunnel (raised $3M, grew to $20M in revenue); led strategy at DOE Media. Manages 100+ ad accounts and teaches live classes twice a week.

## How we work
- Grok Bot scans the Meta Ad Library for long-running competitor ads to find proven angles.
- Claude connects to Google and Meta ad accounts to audit search terms, placements, budgets, and tracking, and flags wasted spend fast.
- Evan reviews every finding and decides what to fix first; fixes go live quickly, and accounts keep being monitored.

## Proof
- $200M+ in ad spend managed over 20+ years.
- 150+ businesses served.
- One client went from $0 to $30k in profitable revenue with Google Ads.
- Public LinkedIn recommendations from Adam Foroughi (CEO, AppLovin; Evan's former manager), Navraj Sran (Google), Ramzey Nassar (Founder, DOE), John Narducci (client; scaled Google close to 7x), and Mark Murrell (Founder/CEO, Get Maine Lobster): https://www.linkedin.com/in/evanabaker/details/recommendations/
